title: Qt: Store Import Hex Dump settings
description:
Store all user specified values from the "Import from Hex Dump"
dialog in a profile import_hexdump.json file.

Set default ExportPDU dissector to "data".
Fixed a minor typo in a help text.

Have you checked if profile import/export is tagging along the file? My guess would be no, as no change to "ProfileModel" has been made. The filename needs to be added to profile_files_ in the constructor of ProfileModel

The issue is, that we need the list in ProfileModel as it packs/unpacks the zips and uses this list as a sanity check to ensure, no illegal files are imported. You don't need to register the file per se, just the name

The filename is also needed for other profile operations, like copy from profile.
Have a look at MR !4251 for a fix.
